_readme: This is the flow registry (blueprint section 9) — the single place a business flow is 'declared' before any test is allowed to claim it. scripts/validate-flows.ts parses this file with plain JSON.parse (no // comments allowed inside 'flows' itself, hence this separate notes block) and fails the build if an id is duplicated, an owner is missing, or a tag doesn't start with '@flow:'.

_fieldNotes.id: Unique id across the whole registry, convention is '<app>.<flow-name>'. Used only inside this file and validate-flows.ts for duplicate detection.
_fieldNotes.name: Human-readable name — should match the tag below without the '@flow:' prefix.
_fieldNotes.tag: Must exactly match the @flow: tag used in the tag array of the corresponding test file (see tests/ui/manage-todos.spec.ts).
_fieldNotes.owner: Placeholder in this scaffold — replace with the real team or person accountable for this flow before using it for real work.
_fieldNotes.status: 'active' | 'deprecated'. Deprecated flows should not gain new tests (blueprint section 9).
_fieldNotes.criticality: 'tier-1' = must always pass in CI; 'tier-2' = smoke-covered but less strict (blueprint section 9).
_fieldNotes.entryPoint: Where in the application this flow starts (a route/URL path).
_fieldNotes.coveragePolicy: Which CI lanes (see .github/workflows/pr-validation.yml) are expected to exercise this flow — e.g. ['smoke'], ['smoke','regression'].
